name: hud_wave_list_boss_checks
description: The waves to come name a boss's own checks on its row (playtest halv s1, f35463: wave 12's row showed the Hollowtide Crest's face and 'boss', and the Winged and Armored glyphs that came with its Duskmoths and Thornbacks: 'had to guess whether it flies'). After 'boss' stand the glyphs of the checks the boss itself tests, as its plate's glyph shows them (Game.creep_checks: the check it brings, and Winged too if it flies): the Bristlesow's and the Crest's Armored, and no Winged glyph for either, since neither flies. The wave's own glyph column is unchanged.

steps.msg: hovering the wave lists all twelve

steps.assert: node('WaveRow12').find_child('BossCheck_armored', true, false) != null and node('WaveRow6').find_child('BossCheck_armored', true, false) != null
steps.msg: the Crest's row and the Bristlesow's show the boss's own Armored glyph

steps.assert: node('WaveRow12').find_child('BossCheck_winged', true, false) == null and node('WaveRow6').find_child('BossCheck_winged', true, false) == null
steps.msg: and no Winged glyph: neither boss flies

steps.assert: node('Hud').wave_list_lines()[11] == '12: winged armored | duskmoth ×6 · 113 hp, thornback ×4 · 300 hp · armour 4, hollowtide_crest boss · 2625 hp · armour 4 (armored)' and node('Hud').wave_list_lines()[5] == '6: armored | thornback ×3 · 180 hp · armour 4, bristlesow boss · 1125 hp · armour 6 (armored)'
steps.msg: each row reads its checks, then its creeps with their numbers, the boss with its own checks
drawn from the painted Armored glyph, named on hover
the wave's glyph column is as before
a creep's own checks: its check, Winged once
